description:
From the fz-kdt.119 cold review (2026-09-01):
FZ_STRESS_REVERSE_DISPATCH_ARMS permutes callsite-dispatch
alternatives (call_destinations) but construction-wrapper SELECTION
plans (the member-matching at backend callable constructions) are
built elsewhere and never perturbed -- which is why the take_drop
dead-and-broken member was invisible to the stress (base stays green
under reversal while carrying a member that fails when reached).
Extend the knob (or add a sibling) to permute wrapper member order;
expected immediate catch: the take_drop blocker. Also fz-kdt.131
needs a CROSS-GROUP permutation stress (the knob only permutes within
question groups) -- one design for both gaps.

comments.text: fz-kdt.141 (2026-09-01) unifies this ticket's wrapper-selection gap with the step-3 review's finding that the reversal stress goes toothless on lists after 107.3 -- one stress design for all the seat-free orderings. This ticket closes as folded into fz-kdt.141 when that lands.

FOLDED INTO fz-kdt.141, which landed the wrapper-permutation sibling this ticket asked for plus the cross-group arm permutation. Close as folded.

One correction this ticket's expectation earned, recorded on fz-kdt.132: the wrapper permutation does NOT catch the take_drop blocker. It reaches the pair (the selection plan's test nodes swap, 972 canon lines on enum_take_drop_split) but reordering makes the dead member live INSTEAD of its sibling rather than alongside it, and each member is self-consistent when it takes every value -- so no order can produce 'matched no member'. What the wrapper half did catch instead is fz-kdt.147: the entire 268-escape surface-membership baseline is wrapper-order-decided, and the settled order is the worst of the legal ones.

title: The arm-reversal stress does not perturb construction-wrapper selection plans
